name: Beispiel: Thermometer (Skript)
author: HyperLED
description: Ein Lua-Skript zeichnet ein Thermometer über das ganze Segment. Zum Lernen.
script:
-- Thermometer: a bar over the whole segment, blue when it is cold and red when it is warm.
-- v.temp is the temperature the plugin read; settings.scale_min / scale_max are the ends of the scale.
fps = 10  -- a bar that changes every few minutes does not need more

local lo = settings.scale_min or -10
local hi = settings.scale_max or 40

function frame(t)
  clear()
  local temp = v.temp
  if temp == nil then
    -- no value yet: one dim dot runs along the segment
    px(math.floor(t / 100) % W, 0, 40, 40, 40)
    return
  end
  local share = (temp - lo) / (hi - lo)
  if share < 0 then share = 0 elseif share > 1 then share = 1 end
  local filled = math.floor(share * W + 0.5)
  local r, g, b = hsv(240 - math.floor(share * 240), 255, 255)
  for y = 0, H - 1 do
    for x = 0, filled - 1 do
      px(x, y, r, g, b)
    end
  end
end
